resources.string: Send the first message to your team.
Couldn’t load the conversation. Saved messages are still here.
Couldn’t save your changes. Please try again.
Couldn’t access saved messages. Please try again.
Couldn’t confirm the messages. Your saved conversation is safe.
Choose how the connection behaves, then open your conversation.
Block all requests. Saved messages stay available.
Every send and retry fails until switched off.
Block the first page and earlier messages.
Send succeeds, but its first reply is lost. Retry confirms the same message.
20% chance per request. Off gives a reliable connection.
Press Back from chat to change these controls, then retry. Changes affect new requests and are remembered after the app restarts.
Saved messages are available. Turn off offline mode in Test controls to send again.
Remove downloaded history to test loading again. Your sent and unsent messages stay saved.
History cache cleared. Start app to load it again.
History is still loading. Please try again when it finishes.
Couldn’t clear history cache. Please try again.
Prepare a Room draft, delay pending retries, or stop the app process to check recovery.
Writes a recognizable draft only if this conversation has no saved draft.
Send with Go offline enabled and wait for Failed. Turn it off, queue the retry here, keep the device connected, and close the app before the delay ends.
Reopen from the launcher to check the saved draft. Do not use Android’s Force stop when checking background work.
Draft sample saved. Start the conversation to see it before restarting.
A saved draft already exists. It was left untouched.
Failed network sends are queued for about one minute from now.
No failed network sends are available to queue.
Saved Room drafts and WorkManager jobs remain on disk. Reopen Rhino Chat from the launcher to continue the check.
